items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: We played with him. I played with Earl.

ctx.x: He played with different bands too then. He was playing... A long time I heard from him was playing with Earl Foster. You know Earl Foster. We played with him. I played with Earl. A long time too. Ooh, long time too.
Ask him did he play clarinet too?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I used to play with him too. Emily's cousin, Earl Foster.

ctx.x: Yeah. I used to play with him too. Emily's cousin, Earl Foster. You never heard of him, eh? Yeah, I know him. That's Anderson's cousin. Yeah. That's a funny story to hear. Tell it, you know. Yeah, after he came up there that night to get me, you know.
Yeah, but he wasn't doing nothing.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: We got Earl you see Earl Foster.

ctx.x: WDSU I think. Could have been WSMB.

We got Earl you see Earl Foster. Earl and Andrew Anderson's cousin you know. Oh yeah. I certainly would like to hear a record of Buddy Petit. Me too. Buddy must have made a record of somebody. You know what I'm saying sir? Cause him and Louis Armstrong was Buddy you know. And you too. Buddy was like that.
But, but Louie never gives Buddy credit.
